Text:
Bună ziua, domnule Popa. Cum vă mai simțiți de data trecută? Bună ziua. Nu prea bine, domnule doctor. Tusea nu a trecut și de trei zile am iar febră, treizeci și opt și ceva seara. Tușiți cu flegmă? Da, dimineața mai ales, e verzuie. Și obosesc foarte repede, abia urc la etajul doi. Fumați în continuare? Am redus la zece țigări pe zi, dar nu m-am lăsat de tot. Să vă ascult plămânii. Respirați adânc pe gură. Încă o dată. Mă cam doare în partea dreaptă când respir adânc. Aud niște raluri la baza plămânului drept. Vreau o radiografie pulmonară astăzi sau cel târziu mâine. Unde o fac? La spitalul județean, la radiologie. Vă dau biletul de trimitere acum și le sunați să vă programeze. Bine. Și cu febra ce fac? Vă prescriu amoxicilină cu acid clavulanic, o mie de miligrame, de două ori pe zi, timp de șapte zile. Pentru febră luați paracetamol, cel mult patru tablete pe zi. Pot să merg la serviciu? Lucrez pe șantier. Nu. Vă dau concediu medical cinci zile, până marți inclusiv. Odihnă și multe lichide. Am nevoie de adeverință pentru patron. Certificatul de concediu medical vi-l eliberez acum, îl duceți la resurse umane. Mulțumesc. Și analizele? Faceți și o hemoleucogramă și proteina C reactivă, mâine dimineață, pe nemâncate. Le fac mâine. Când vin înapoi? Vă aștept marți, zece noiembrie, la ora opt și jumătate, cu radiografia și analizele. Dacă vă e greu să respirați sau febra trece de treizeci și nouă, veniți imediat sau sunați la urgență. Am înțeles. Și cu fumatul? Vă recomand programul de renunțare la fumat de la dispensar. Vă trec pe listă și vă sună doamna asistentă Elena săptămâna viitoare. Bine, o să încerc. Mulțumesc, domnule doctor.

You are a senior Project Manager with a rigorous, execution-focused mindset. You receive (part of) the
Transcript of a Session (one recorded conversation) and must extract every Proposed Action: a concrete
action someone has to carry out. The Transcript comes from speech recognition and has no speaker labels.

What is a Proposed Action:
- Any commitment or request to do something: "X, can you ...?" followed by agreement, "please send ...",
  "I'll do it", "I'll ask IT today".
- Include small items too: giving someone access, sending a draft, checking figures, writing rules,
  calling someone, submitting something for approval.
- One action per Proposed Action: split "write the tests and update the docs" into two Proposed Actions.
- NOT a Proposed Action: items that were cancelled or dropped ("we won't do X anymore" - record it as a decision),
  ideas nobody committed to, and decisions.

Owner:
- The person who accepted the action or was asked to do it, written as in the transcript.
- If a Proposed Action was reassigned ("Ionuț was supposed to, but Elena takes it over"), use only the final owner.
- If the speaker commits themself ("I'll do it", "I'll send it") and their name is not stated, owner=null.
  Never pick a person who is only mentioned in the sentence.
- If assignable team members are provided and the transcript names no owner, choose one only when their
  skills clearly match the action; use the exact candidate name. Otherwise owner=null.

Due date:
- Resolve "today", "tomorrow", weekday names ("by Monday", "on Thursday") and "next week" with the
  calendar above. "By Monday" means that Monday.
- If no deadline is stated, due_date=null. The date of a later session is not a deadline unless the action
  has to be finished before it.

Rules:
- Response language: English.
- Do not invent information that is not present in the transcript.
- Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD.
- Remove duplicates. Keep actions separate from decisions and risks.
- transcript_excerpt: the shortest transcript quote (at most 15 words) that shows the action.

Return ONLY valid JSON, with no extra text, using this schema:

{
  "session_summary": "maximum 4 sentences",
  "proposed_actions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "title": "infinitive verb + clear objective",
      "description": "one short sentence",
      "owner": "person name or null",
      "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
      "priority": "high|medium|low",
      "transcript_excerpt": "short quote from the transcript"
    }
  ],
  "decisions": ["decisions made in the session"],
  "risks": ["identified blockers or risks"],
  "follow_up_questions": ["questions needed for actions with unclear owner/deadline"]
}

Transcript:
Good morning, Mr. Popa. How are you feeling now? Good morning. Not very well, Doctor. The cough hasn't gone away, and for three days I've had a fever, thirty-eight and something in the evening. Do you cough with phlegm? Yes, mostly in the morning, it's green. And I get very tired, barely making it to the second floor. Do you still smoke? I've reduced to ten cigarettes a day, but I haven't quit completely. Let me listen to your lungs. Breathe deeply through your mouth. Again. It hurts a bit on the right side when I breathe deeply. I hear some crackles at the base of the right lung. I want a chest X-ray today or at the latest tomorrow. Where do I get it done? At the county hospital, in radiology. I'll give you the referral now and you call to schedule an appointment. Okay. And what about the fever? I'll prescribe amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, one thousand milligrams, twice a day, for seven days. For the fever, take paracetamol, no more than four tablets a day. Can I go to work? I work on a construction site. No. I'll give you a medical leave of absence for five days, up to Tuesday inclusive. Rest and drink plenty of fluids. I need a certificate for my employer. I'll issue the medical leave certificate now, you take it to human resources. Thank you. And the tests? Do a complete blood count and C-reactive protein, tomorrow morning, on an empty stomach. I'll do them tomorrow. When should I come back? I'll be waiting on Tuesday, November tenth, at half past ten, with the X-ray and the tests. If you have difficulty breathing or the fever goes above thirty-nine, come immediately or call the emergency department. I understand. And regarding smoking? I recommend the smoking cessation program at the clinic. I'll put you on the list and the assistant, Mrs. Elena, will call you next week. Okay, I'll try. Thank you, Doctor.
